notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment made the italic *gave him* one `added` unit under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause. That clause governs a clause whose Hebrew has no verb, and here וַיִּתְּנוּ stands in the clause with two marked objects coordinated under it. Rule 34's pro-verb clause governs instead: *gave* names the very verb the Hebrew wrote — the ASV rewrote that verb's clause in other words for the second object — so it joins s008's one discontinuous unit, headed on *put*, and only the supplied object *him* remains `added` under rule 44.

The margin's alternative rendering *put upon him the crown and the testimony* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38), and it is the rendering the two-realization reading answers to.
